_doc: Rules for check_link_closure.py (spec 6.3 path rule, section 8 K2/W2). Target names and external library basenames are matched exactly, never by substring. include_patterns are Python regexes searched against each include directory with any trailing '/' removed.

K2._doc: dinero_consensus closure must be storage-free and node-free.
K2.node_source_dirs_reason: spec §6.3: any source under src/{daemon,rpc,storage,p2p,wallet} inside a storage-free library must be allowlisted

W2._doc: dinero_wallet closure: K2 minus sqlite3 and dinero_wallet, plus targets with src/p2p/ sources; lightning_core_static allowed.
W2.allowed_targets_reason: W2 allows lightning_core_static (spec section 8); its own dependencies are still walked
W2.node_source_dirs_reason: spec §6.3 path rule; src/wallet/ is omitted because it is the wallet's own code
